title: Liste des intermédiaires d’assurances
producer: Autorité de Contrôle des Assurances et de la Prévoyance Sociale (ACAPS)
acquisition: Public HTML directory tables retrieved from acaps.ma; general pagination cross-checked against the published city filters. The Excel download link returned HTTP 404.
transformations: Decode HTML entities and trim/collapse display whitespace; retain blank names, insurers and localities as null.
Map AGENT to agent, COURTIER to broker and BUREAU DE GESTION DIRECTE to direct-office.
Lowercase insurer labels to merge case-only source variations. Preserve ACAPS codes, names and locality labels.
Merge identical five-field records and sort by code and field values for stable pagination. Retain conflicting records sharing an ACAPS code.
limitations: No open license identified. ACAPS legal terms restrict reproduction without authorization; redistribution permission has not been obtained.
A dated directory snapshot, not a real-time authorization check. Absence does not establish that an intermediary is unauthorized.
Source update frequency and last modification date are not documented on the directory page.
Includes agents, brokers and direct management offices. Business names or professional representatives may identify individuals.
ACAPS codes are not unique in the source: COU5081-00000 appears with different locality and insurer values. Code lookup returns every matching record.
Source locality spelling, encoding issues and missing fields are preserved. City search matches text, not verified administrative boundaries.
Only the five directory columns are retained; no addresses, personal contact details or current authorization status are inferred.
